title: Model A — poll binding for a direct intent (no ScenarioBundle)
description: Intent created directly via POST /v1/intents to a poll-delivery-mode agent. The agent does NOT hold a persistent connection. It periodically calls GET /v1/agents/{address}/intents?since=cursor to check for new intents. When it finds the new intent, it validates the batch payload and resumes. Tests poll binding for Model A.

agents.description: polls for pending intents, validates batch spec, resumes
